about: The three repairs to the AI-assisted port, as edits by file and line number. Each edit names the SHA-256 of the line it expects (the line's text without its line ending, UTF-8); sides/fix_port.py refuses to change anything unless every expected line is there. No text of the port is stored here: the port has no licence and is fetched at run time into cache/, never committed. README.md, 'What differs, and why', gives the COBOL behind each repair.

edits.why: defect 2: the high-rate RHC flag set for a short CHC day; only the RHC paragraph sets RHC-HIGH-DAY-IND (HOSPR210.cbl:6055), and the return code comes from it (:6274-6312)
defect 1: the high-rate RHC day counter incremented for a short CHC day; only the RHC paragraph writes BILL-HIGH-RHC-DAYS (HOSPR210.cbl:6036)
defect 2: the low-rate RHC flag set for a short CHC day; only the RHC paragraph sets RHC-LOW-DAY-IND (HOSPR210.cbl:6018)
defect 1: the low-rate RHC day counter incremented for a short CHC day; only the RHC paragraph writes BILL-LOW-RHC-DAYS (HOSPR210.cbl:5997)
defect 3: the CHC hourly rate rounded half-up at ten places; the COBOL truncates it (HOSPR210.cbl:6430-6434 into PIC 9(06)V9(02) at :207), as CMS's own Java does at four places
